components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single Join or submit action in one decision area.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.18 0.025 265); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px 20px; background: oklch(0.67 0.19 45); color: oklch(0.18 0.025 265); font: 650 14px/1.2 Arial, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 oklch(0.18 0.025 265 / 0.28); } .ds-primary:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: none; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.49 0.22 272); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: State Control
components.description: A bounded sentence or activity choice with an explicit selected state.
components.css: .ds-state { min-height: 46px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.86 0.018 265); border-radius: 999px; padding: 12px 18px; background: oklch(0.94 0.035 272); color: oklch(0.18 0.025 265); font: 650 14px/1.2 Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-state[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: oklch(0.49 0.22 272); background: oklch(0.49 0.22 272); color: white; } .ds-state:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.49 0.22 272); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labelled contact field with a persistent visible label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: oklch(0.18 0.025 265); font-family: Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.86 0.018 265); border-radius: 8px; padding: 13px 14px; background: white; color: oklch(0.18 0.025 265); font-size: 16px; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.49 0.22 272); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Journal Link
components.description: A title-led editorial row that remains useful without its companion preview.
components.html:
Club story · 25 August 2026

A room made for trying again
components.css: .ds-story { padding-block: 24px; border-top: 1px solid oklch(0.86 0.018 265); } .ds-story h3 { margin: 8px 0 0; font: 650 clamp(26px, 4vw, 52px)/1 Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.035em; } .ds-story a { color: oklch(0.18 0.025 265); text-decoration: none; } .ds-story a:hover { color: oklch(0.49 0.22 272); } .ds-story a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid oklch(0.49 0.22 272); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview: Language moves from a sentence-led hero into a prompt, from a prompt into an activity, from an activity into a story, and from a story into a real contact intent. The default surface is clean and bright. One generated room scene fades behind the hero; documentary photography supplies selective proof after the interface has established the idea.
keyCharacteristics: Language-led identity with complete server-rendered content.
One committed cobalt and one response orange.
Asymmetrical whitespace instead of repeated cards.
User-controlled state choreography with reduced-motion parity.
One replaceable generated hero atmosphere, sparse documentary media, and one persistent site-wide theme choice.

rules.name: Words Are the Instrument
rules.body: A route must remain visually finished when optional photography is removed.

rules.name: The One Room Rule
rules.body: A page uses one complete theme. Sections do not create unrelated local dark modes.

rules.name: The Response Rule
rules.body: Signal Orange marks the Join action, a selected response, or successful completion.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Bricolage Grotesque supplies every public type role; contrast comes from scale and composition.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Do not combine a border, large radius, and wide shadow to simulate a generic card.

dos: Do make the subject interactive through real sentences and prompts.
Do preserve complete server HTML, keyboard access, touch access, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do let one selected state recompose an entire companion field.
Do keep photographs sparse, consent-gated, and factually captioned.
Do use Heroicons SVG components for functional symbols instead of Unicode or ASCII glyphs.
Do treat light and dark as complete semantic token mappings.
donts: Do not build three equal feature cards, generic bento boxes, or icon-above-title grids.
Do not use gradient text, decorative gradients, blobs, glass, glow, particles, 3D letters, or a custom cursor; one functional hero media fade is allowed.
Do not add fake data, scores, progress, metrics, schedules, testimonials, or partner marks.
Do not auto-rotate content, hijack scroll, or put a photograph on every fold.
Do not add microphone, camera, speech recognition, or account requirements.
